features.notes: Task 0 V5 re-run on v0.50.0 (runtime/bin/ailang 6abe1a5): encode 0.1+0.2 -> {"x":0.30000000000000004} on --strict-bytecode VM and interpreter (identical); 0.1, 1-2^-52, 5e-324, phiCap and 2^53-1 round-trip through std/json on both. Edge floats: std/json v0.50.0 prints -0.0 as "0" and whole floats as integer digits (1e308 -> 309-digit integer) and decode saturates integer literals >= 2^63 at 9223372036854775807, so -0.0 and 1e308 do NOT round-trip through std/json (same on VM and interpreter, no divergence). Codec choice kept (std/json shortest digits); protocol.num repairs both: '-0.0' and exponent form for integer text > 17 digits or < 1e-6 (JS-style). Reported to controller for upstream. AC8 PASS: cd sim && $A test --package . -> 44/44 (20 protocol_test: 8 v1.1 kept unchanged + 12 v2: float text, input/state/hello round trips incl. 0.1, 1-2^-52, 5e-324, 1e308, -0.0, phiCap, 2^53-1, every intent kind; reason codes bad_json/bad_v/bad_cmd/bad_tick/bad_step/bad_intent/bad_heading/bad_game/bad_params; handshake no_hello/no_game; malformed keeps tick; refused (diag_only/moving/unsupported) proceeds; diag adapter == core.turn/step bit-exact; change-sets; v1.1 routing until v2 hello). AC10 part PASS: make strict -> strict protocolVm: protocol-ok, 13 lines, strict VM = interpreter. make test green (v1.1 bridge 0 failures, parity 601 lines, parity-offaxis 17 lines unchanged) + new parity-v2 (14-line v2 session through ship.ail, VM == interpreter). Mutations killed (9/9 via protocolVm): -0.0 normalised, tick < instead of ==, refused stalls tick, new_game before hello, big floats as integer digits, tiny floats as long decimals, dtau upper bound dropped, params range unchecked, refusals unordered. Deviations: unsolicited v1.1 startup line kept until M2.1b (v1.1 bridge waits for it before hello); v2 replies nothing before hello and refuses new_game/input with no_hello. Added codes bad_game/bad_params/no_hello/no_game (new_game schema/params not covered by the design's list). Ship view carries x (for M2.1b AC13 equivalence); ISM/CMB readouts, journey/ledger/rng sections deferred to M2.2+. AILANG bug found: `ailang test` conflates same-named private functions across modules (protocol.reject vs ship.reject -> 'record has no field: motion'); `ailang run` on VM and interpreter is correct; worked around by renaming to malformed; minimal repro in PR. std/string.repeat is not wired on the strict VM (replaced by recursion). ~305 counted code LOC (protocol.ail 265, ship.ail +25, Makefile +14, toml +1) + 214 test LOC = ~519 (cap 650).
